summary: Tested Mobile Navigation Adaptive (Mobile/Desktop), Admin Mobile Dashboard with Scanner QR, role verification, and design. All features working correctly. Mobile navigation ONLY appears on viewport < 768px. Admin Mobile Dashboard accessible with valid admin session and shows Scanner QR button, stats (Total, Aujourd'hui, En attente), and Dernières inscriptions list.

issues: Cookie banner still shows despite localStorage cc2026_cookies_accepted being set - requires manual dismiss via click

critical_code_review_comments: useDeviceDetect.js correctly uses window.innerWidth < 768 for mobile detection
MobileBottomNav.jsx uses md:hidden CSS class and isMobile from useDeviceDetect for double protection
AdminMobileDashboard.jsx has proper data-testid attributes (admin-mobile-dashboard, scan-qr-button)
MobileBottomNav.jsx shows different navs based on: isInAdminArea && isAdmin, isInProArea && isPro, else public nav
Scanner QR button uses html5-qrcode library for badge scanning
Design follows light theme (#F4F1EA background, #1A1A14 text) as specified
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile navigation works correctly with viewport breakpoint at 768px. Admin session requires role: 'admin' stored in sessionStorage 'workspace_user' or localStorage 'cc2026_session'. To test admin features, login via /admin with password 'CC2026admin'. Use localStorage.setItem('kk_visited', 'true') and localStorage.setItem('cc2026_cookies_accepted', 'true') to bypass intro and cookies in tests.
